company_name: Shandong Liguan Micro Electronics Equipment Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Shandong Liguan is a leading provider of advanced semiconductor equipment manufacturing and process technology services.
summary: Shandong Liguan Micro Electronics Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of advanced semiconductor process equipment, covering the first to fourth generation semiconductor materials. The company integrates R&D, production, and sales to deliver tailored equipment solutions for various electronic devices, including integrated circuits and MEMS.
capabilities: Equipment for integrated circuits and power semiconductors

regional_presence.China: Shandong Liguan has a strong presence in the Chinese semiconductor industry, focusing on domestic substitution and high-quality development.
